apps.name: BYD Sea Lion 06
apps.localizedDescription: Компаньйон для BYD Sea Lion 06: стан авто, клімат, сидіння, камери.

versions.localizedDescription:
### Added
- **One command for the UI tests: `scripts/e2e.sh <head-unit|companion-android|companion-ios|all>`.** The head-unit
  flows run on a new AVD `byd_head_unit`, shaped like the car (1920×1080, 240 dpi, landscape, API 32), instead of a
  phone turned on its side.
  - Each run boots its own read-only emulator or simulator, so parallel sessions never share one.
  - It installs only on that emulator and refuses a device of the wrong shape.
  - Every flow and broker check gets a hard time limit, and the results go to one summary.
  - A whole target now takes one to three minutes; the autotester rounds of 2026-11-15/16 took 40–65 minutes each.
  - Rules: `openspec/changes/ui-test-harness/`.
- **Test tags in the companion apps.** Every control and asserted value has an id that Maestro sees on Android and
  iOS alike, so the flows no longer match Ukrainian text or tap screen coordinates. Nothing visible changes. On
  Android, TalkBack now reads the child-lock button's state too («Ліві задні двері, —»), as VoiceOver already did.

### Changed
- **Icons from Material Design Icons.** The companion apps and the HA card use `mdi-car-seat` for the Сидіння tab,
  `mdi-air-conditioner` for the Клімат tab (was a fan), and `mdi-lock-outline` / `mdi-lock-open-outline` wherever a
  locked or unlocked state is drawn (lock pill, status chip, quick actions, child-lock buttons). The head-unit test
  panel's Сидіння and Клімат tabs get the same seat and air-conditioner glyphs. MDI is Apache-2.0
  (`companion/design-assets/MDI-LICENSE.txt`). Figma shows the same glyphs.
